## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Tang Esoteric ritual manual translated by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA), 705–774). Colophon: *特進試鴻臚卿大興善寺三藏沙門大廣智不空奉詔譯*. The text functions as the *yíguǐ* (ritual procedure) companion to the *Mahāpratisarā* sūtra-cycle [KR6j0371](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0371) (T1153) and [KR6j0373](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0373) (T1154), specifying the visualisations, *mudrās*, *mantras*, and procedural steps for the operative rite.

**Abstract**

The text opens with **Cuīèqù Bodhisattva** (滅惡趣菩薩, *Apāya-vidhvaṃsana-bodhisattva*, "Bodhisattva-Who-Destroys-the-Evil-Destinies") rising from his seat in the great assembly of *Vairocana Buddha* (毘盧遮那佛) and addressing the Buddha: he wishes to expound, on behalf of the beings of evil destinies in the future *latter-dharma defiled-mixture world* (當來末法雜染世界惡趣眾生), a *dhāraṇī of sin-destroying-and-Buddhahood-realising* (滅罪成佛陀羅尼). The Buddha grants permission. The text then presents the full ritual sequence: enthronement of *Mahāpratisarā* in the *Vajraśekhara* mandala system, the eight *mudrā*-cycle, the *mantra* sequence, the visualisation-procedure, and the *siddhi*-application for both worldly fulfilment and supramundane Buddhahood-realisation. The text systematically integrates the *Mahāpratisarā* formula into the *Vajraśekhara*-mandala framework that defines Amoghavajra's mature Esoteric synthesis. It belongs with [KR6j0371](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0371), [KR6j0373](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0373), [KR6j0375](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0375), [KR6j0376](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0376) and [KR6j0377](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0377) in the cluster of Tang–Liáo–Sòng material on the *Mahāpratisarā* cycle.
